text: Micah Jared Smith, of Wilmington, Delaware, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of August 5, 2019; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and the time to file a response having expired; It is ordered that Micah Jared Smith is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
